description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_file, which models the handling and validation of file URI schemes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes properties indicating the usability of file URIs and a method to validate and sanitize URI components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_file
classes.description: A class representing the file URI scheme, extending the HTMLPurifier_URIScheme base class, providing properties and a method for validation of file URIs.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the given URI object by removing userinfo, port, and query components, returning true to indicate successful validation.
